settings.update.title: Update
settings.update.terminal: Also `daoris-driver update --when-idle|--now|--cancel` — one file, either door.
settings.update.why: A build staged beside this install by publish:desktop --stage is installed when its work allows: nothing new starts, the sessions running end or park, and once no driven session runs and no conversation is mid-turn, Daoris closes, its launcher puts the build in place, and Daoris starts again. Not now keeps the build staged and lets work go on, for that build only. Update now closes Daoris at once, and each session it cut is carried on after the start. A build that fails its check, or does not come up, is put aside, and the build before it runs. In a terminal, plain daoris-driver update says what is staged and how the last update ended.
settings.update.none: Nothing is staged beside this install.
settings.update.draining: Installs when the work running now ends; nothing new starts meanwhile.
settings.update.nothingRuns: Nothing runs now, so it installs at the next look.
settings.update.waiting: You said Not now: work goes on, and this build waits for your word.
settings.update.applying: Installing: Daoris closes and starts again in a moment.
settings.update.refused: Not installed: {{why}} It is not tried again; the next build staged replaces it.
